```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Ruby
      uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
      with:
        ruby-version: '3.1'
        bundler-cache: true

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: bundle install

    - name: Run tests
      run: bundle exec rake test

    - name: Lint Markdown
      uses: DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2-action@07035fd053f7be764496c0f8d8f9f41f98305101
      with:
        fix: true
        globs: '**/*.md'

    - name: Autofix PRs
      uses: autofix-ci/action@635ffb0c9798bd160680f18fd73371e355b85f27
      with:
        fail-fast: false
        commit-message: "chore: autoformat"
        comment: "Automated formatting changes"

    - name: Update documentation
      run: |
        # Placeholder for updating documentation
        echo "Updating documentation..."
        git add docs/
        git commit -m "docs: update documentation"
        git push origin main
```

This workflow sets up a basic CI pipeline for the `sous-chefs/haproxy` repository using GitHub Actions. It includes steps for checking out the repository, setting up Ruby, installing dependencies, running tests, linting Markdown files, automatically fixing PRs, and updating documentation. Adjustments can be made as needed to fit the specific requirements of the project.
